ideas.title: Following the Money in California Election Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and potential money laundering schemes involved in the alleged election fraud in California
questions: What financial transactions are involved in the alleged election fraud?
Are there any potential money laundering schemes?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover the extent of the alleged election fraud and identify potential perpetrators. This investigation could also reveal patterns of financial wrongdoing that could be used to prevent future instances of election fraud.
